title: Lodge world?
content: I like following this sub although I've never been to mall world...reminds me of that weird mall episode in the last season of Atlanta. I do relate to mall world and I ve thought about writing this else where but here seems like the only place that would understand. My dreams are always in some sort of lodge/campus. Think large ski lodge or university campus building. They are always different with tons of rooms to wander, there are people there, and they are laid out like erratic dreamscape design. Occasional they are half ruined but usually not. Most of my dreams end up being me looking for something or trying to avoid something, by going through these weird dream scape buildings. I've been outside a few times but it's usually to get to another sprawling building. What do you all think? Does mall world have a Scooby Doo-ish ski lodge above it or a university next door?
